Hi Heliumdeploy,

If Heliumdeploy runs on Shopify, Shop Campaigns might be worth a look. The
cost model is different from most ad channels: you're charged when a new
customer places an order, not for clicks or impressions.

Your products would show up in the Shop app, where shoppers already check
out with Shop Pay in one tap.

I'd set it up with a cost per new customer that you choose, and tie it into
the same tracking you already use for Search Console and your social
accounts. That way everything sits in one view, and you can see what each
new customer actually cost you.

Would you be open to trying it on a small budget first? Happy to walk you
through how it would look.
